body: For some reason when I test this in the bevy repo by modifying one of the examples, it works as expected.

After adding "rust-version = "1.79.0" and removing the following from my cargo.toml, it works as expected - currently trying to narrow down which one causes the issue
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7a3f480c-da7c-4f78-8b3a-99e21d80bad8)

These lines in the cargo.toml seems to be causing this (it happens if either is present)

```
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 3
```
Thanks for narrowing it down! Now we just need to figure out a solution.
